nodes.label: Ban System API Client.  Client for interacting with the BedolagaBan monitoring
HTTP client for Ban System API.
Get statistics for a specific period.          GET /api/stats/period?hours={ho
Get list of users with pagination.          GET /api/users          Args:
Get users who exceeded their device limit.          GET /api/users/over-limit
Get user network information (WiFi/Mobile detection).          GET /api/users/
Get list of active punishments (bans).          GET /api/punishments
Get punishment history for a user.          GET /api/history/{query}
Get list of connected nodes.          GET /api/nodes
Get list of monitoring agents.          GET /api/agents          Args:
Get summary statistics for all agents.          GET /api/agents/summary
Get top users by traffic.          GET /api/traffic/top
Get traffic information for a specific user.          GET /api/traffic/user/{u
Get list of traffic limit violations.          GET /api/traffic/violations
Get all settings with their definitions.          GET /api/settings
Get a specific setting value.          GET /api/settings/{key}
